title: Cincin Longgar
subject: a young goldsmith in a Pasar Atom Surabaya stall who resizes the same engagement ring three times because the customer's girlfriend's finger swells in the heat, until the man asks him to make it one size loose so it can stay on through every season
caption: Balkan turbo-folk, driving 9/8 dance groove with a 2+2+2+3 stomp. Clarinet playing fast ornamented melody lines with quarter-tone slides, piano accordion answering in short staccato phrases, synth strings holding sustained chords, darbuka and live kick on the stomp, rounded bass guitar. Glossy club-folk mix, tight drums, bright accordion. Male vocal, mid-high register, bold and cheeky, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, A minor. Playful, stomping mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drops, no rap, no electric guitar solo, no reggaeton rhythm.
lyrics:
[Intro - clarinet and accordion]

[Verse 1]
Tiga kali kamu datang ke tokoku
Cincin yang sama, ukuran yang lain
Katamu jarinya kembung kena panas
Waktu hujan cincinnya lepas sendiri

[Pre-Chorus]
Kukikir, kuukur, kusepuh lagi
Kamu tawar sambil senyum sendiri

[Chorus]
Cincin longgar, cincin sempit, mana yang pas
Emas dua puluh empat, hatimu belum jelas
Cincin longgar, cincin sempit, ayo tentukan
Aku tukang emas, bukan tukang ramalan

[Verse 2]
Bulan Agustus jarinya gemuk sedikit
Bulan Desember katanya kurus lagi
Kamu bawa kotak merah buat kali keempat
Aku sudah hafal angka di buku catatan

[Pre-Chorus]
Kukikir, kuukur, kusepuh lagi
Kamu diam, lalu bilang pelan

[Chorus]
Cincin longgar, cincin longgar, kasih satu ukuran lebih
Biar tetap di jarinya waktu panas dan hujan
Cincin longgar, cincin longgar, jangan terlalu pas
Cinta bukan kotak sempit, katamu, aku setuju

[Outro - accordion and clarinet]
